pages.markdown:
# 6. ECO CIRCLE COMPETENCE FRAMEWORK
  • To understand the meaning of reducing, reusing and recycling and how they connect
  • To understand the importance of the 3 Rs as waste management
  • To be familiar with the expansion of the 3 Rs - the 7 Rs
  • To implement different ways of waste management into daily life
  • To properly implement recycling in day-to-day activities
  • To promote reducing and reusing before recycling
  • To acquire a proactive approach to implementing the 3 Rs into daily personal life
  • To educate others on the importance of sustainable waste management
Competence Area #1 THE 3 Rs: RECYCLE-REUSE-REDUCE
Competence Statement To know the basics of the 3 Rs and their importance and implementation into daily life in relation to green entrepreneurship and circular economy.
Learning Outcomes
Knowledge
Skills
Attitudes and Values
